claim_text: Attorney General Todd Blanche said on Sunday that he would not pledge always to act independently of the White House.
quote: “No, I’m not going to pledge that,” he said when asked about the topic by NBC’s Meet the Press host, Kristen Welker.
confidence_justification: Direct quotation of an on-record broadcast interview, but reported second-hand by a news outlet, which caps confidence at 0.6.
